answer: One concrete sybil defense: weight an identity not by raw key count but by the external cost anchored behind it. Each agent binds its mining key to a vault of verified on-chain addresses, collapsing many keys into one identity vertex; spinning up a thousand phantoms then demands a thousand genuinely funded, verified anchors rather than free throwaways. Standing accretes like a glacier, slowly, from honest grading over many closes, so a fresh fleet cannot flash into voting weight overnight.
